paragraphs: The Defender 300Tdi is a 2.5-litre four-cylinder diesel engine that was fitted to classic Defender 90, 110 and 130 models from roughly 1994 through to 2007. It replaced the earlier 200Tdi and ran alongside the Td5 for a period, depending on market and specification. Like its predecessor, the 300Tdi is mechanically simple and known for its durability — but the cylinder head is a known wear point, and the timing belt interval is critical to maintain. The engine was also used in the Discovery 1 and early Discovery 2, though the Defender application is the most widely recognised. The 300Tdi is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Defender 300Tdi Engine Specifications 300Tdi A 2.5-litre inline-four diesel fitted to the Defender 300Tdi from approximately 1994 to 2007 (Classic 90/110/130). Known for cylinder head cracking and cooling system neglect over time — see the callout above. We inspect and replace the timing belt, cylinder head components and cooling system as standard on every 300Tdi rebuild, along with injectors and gaskets where needed. Check Your 300Tdi Defender → [link to quote form] Defender 300Tdi Engine Compatibility Because the classic Defender used several diesel engines across its long production run — 200Tdi, 300Tdi and Td5 — fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts will interchange can create compatibility problems. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (200Tdi, 300Tdi or Td5) via registration or VIN Your chassis type (90, 110 or 130) Drivetrain and ancillary specification Any specific parts differences relevant to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. Do you supply used Defender 300Tdi engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Defender 300Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Defender 300Tdi from 2023 to present. The 300Tdi features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older 300Tdi V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every 300Tdi rebuild.
